system.description: Starting at 20th level, your chakra has become boundless. Your Crash ignites your chakra coils like a solar flare, and your Flow hums like a perfect current. You have become the pinnacle of Ninjutsu refinement, pushing on the very limits of chakra itself. When you would enter either your Crash or Flow state, you can spend 4 Focus, perfecting them for the next minute. Once you do this, you cannot do so again for 10 minutes.
